Animesh Jain.

Principal Engineer · Writer · Girl Dad

I’m an engineer, writer, and dad to two daughters. I like understanding how things work—from software to history to the choices that shape our lives. Nine cities and two countries later, I’m in Hyderabad, still building things, asking questions, and writing my way through the answers.

01 / WORK

Systems, agents,
and the work between.

WHAT I’M CURRENTLY BUILDING

Organizational AI.
Governance built in.

My current focus is the coordination layer between knowledge, decisions, and execution: agents, services, and people advancing shared work.

Orchestration. Event-driven workflows, durable work state, and independent capabilities. A lightweight agent coordinates the next actions; Service Bus and APIM connect events and managed APIs.

Governance & quality. Validate actions before execution, preserve evidence, and build review and evaluation into the workflow. Human judgment stays where it matters.

OTHER PROJECTS ALONG THE WAY

Prompted the prompts.

RAG. Semantic Kernel. Finding the words—and the context—that make a model useful.

Looped the loops.

Reason, act, observe, continue. Tool dispatch, execution state, and knowing when to stop.

Harnessed the harnesses.

Context, tools, and boundaries around the model. Work that can be inspected and maintained.

Modeled the models.

Fine-tuning and explorations in reinforcement learning.

HOW I GOT HERE

Learning

At SASTRA, a bachelor’s in Computer Science & Engineering came with a student programming club and an appetite for explaining how things work. Then Purdue University: a master’s in Computer and Information Technology, taking that curiosity into data and systems.

Building

Four years as a software engineer at FactSet, then Microsoft in 2018. Software Engineer, Senior, now Principal—the systems have grown, and so have the questions I want to answer.
